reason: Provides AI-accessible webpage fetching through configured third-party providers, with provider routing, structured results, budgets, caching, and optional local Crawl4AI integration.

summaries.zh: 通过用户配置的第三方服务为 AI 抓取网页全文，并提供服务商路由、结构化结果、会话预算、缓存和可选的本地 Crawl4AI 集成。
summaries.en: Fetches full webpage content for AI through user-configured third-party services, with provider routing, structured results, session budgets, caching, and optional local Crawl4AI integration.

capabilities: Fetches webpage content through user-configured third-party services
Uses provider API keys from managed credentials storage
Applies per-session fetch budgets, fallback routing, and in-memory caching
Can start and monitor a local Crawl4AI Docker-based service when configured
